svg.text: Rectangle X -125 to 125, Y -115 to 105 (250 x 220). NOT
centered in Y: 5 mm more to the front.
Ø4.4 thru at X ±85, Y +50 and Y -20.
Ø10.2, 3.1 deep from the TOP face, at X ±114, Y +70 and Y -80.
Sketch on XY: rectangle + 4 chamfers -> Extrude 5. Sketch
circles on top face -> Extrude cut (thru / 3.1).
1. Origin = turret pan axis (center of the top hole), Z0 = bottom face.
2. Printed holes come out ~0.2 small: test-print one hole first.
3. Print flat. Needs a bed at least 250 x 220.
